fact: The Empreende+ programme, run by the Directorate of Entrepreneurship, REINA and UNDP, held a pitch competition on 22 November 2023 whose 3 to 9 winners received grants of 222,000 to 666,000 dobras.
title: Programa Empreende+
publisher: Direção do Empreendedorismo, Ministério da Juventude e Desporto de São Tomé e Príncipe
